## Objective
- Finish the existing Portuguese-language Three.js survival game as a complete, playable experience.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at finish.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Retain the existing Three.js survival game and Portuguese-language interface.
- Inventory reflects carried resources, not duplicate found-loot entries.
- Improve route navigation by placing supply crates in the road, moving cars away from the center, and reducing zombie pressure.
- Check extraction proximity before loot interaction and allow extraction within 8.5 units.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated inventory counts/capacity, start-screen controls guidance, favicon, status-panel spacing, and movement collision handling.
- Removed the temporary `window.__diag` hook from `game.js`.
- Adjusted vehicle, crate, and zombie placement/behavior; widened extraction interaction range and prioritized it over nearby loot.
- Validated inventory use/healing, shooting/reloading, and collecting supplies in earlier gameplay checks.

### Active
- Fix and verify extraction end-screen visibility: `finish()` sets the end-screen visibility, but browser checks still report `#endScreen` as `modal-screen` with computed `display: none` and `#againBtn` invisible.
- Verify restart after a successful run and combat elimination.
- Refresh and read `screenshots/latest.jpg` after the latest code changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reproduce extraction from a fresh page, inspect why `#endScreen` does not retain its `visible` class despite `finish()` being called, and fix it.
2. Verify the success screen and restart, then test combat elimination and restart.
3. Save/read the latest screenshot and check `git status`; summarize the uncommitted changes and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Gameplay, extraction interaction, game-ending logic, and restart handlers.
- `index.html`: Game interface and modal screens.
- `style.css`: Modal visibility rules.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Most recent visual-check artifact; refresh and inspect after fixes.

## Important Context
- Win condition: collect three supplies, reach the shelter near `z = -72`, and press E.
- `finish(success)` updates the result text and applies `visible` to `#endScreen`, but repeated browser checks observed `modal-screen`, `display: none`, and an invisible restart button.
- Changes remain uncommitted in `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.

- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

- `game.js`: Gameplay, extraction interaction, combat, and game-ending logic.

- `style.css`: Modal visibility and game presentation.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Latest visual-check artifact from earlier verification.
